title: Load-safe exchange: independently observable temporary-path cuts and finite recovery
status_authority: Whole supplied scientific sources at exact scope; no Capital scientific model execution or independent audit.
reported_status: P1 constructs a six-strut bypass with two independently releasable, locally measured captive gap stages per leg, two service-joint families, an observation-only transfer/recovery policy and finite stocks. The model completes500 supported-envelope attempts with26 challenges, while two outside-envelope double-fault attempts remain incomplete; physical exchanges performed=0. Conservative motion allowance1.000509mm narrowly exceeds1mm, and complete500-cycle operational labor improves only4.63 times against the strong assisted case. No qualified full physical service, tenfold scheduled-work reduction or advantage over competent automation.

Bounded purpose-built accessible terrestrial fixture family, initially serviceable connection, simultaneous total resultant force≤1kN and moment≤250Nm INCLUDING deployed module, adapters and tool reactions. Replace fastening/key or pin/bush wear sets in bolted-face and fixed-strut-end joints; qualify replacement while every temporary path has a locally observed cut and nearby retained catch, then recover temporary anchors, tooling and stocks. Bounded calibrated force/gap errors, known contact/stiffness range and explicit independent single-fault escape; not arbitrary legacy retrofit or arbitrary hidden defect certification.
